changes.rationale: Make Term hierarchy definition domain-neutral without creating another referent identity, changing graph ownership, or borrowing Entity qualification relations.
Check source-backed Term hierarchy implication, including operational vocabulary, and complete traceable governed-only selection without fabricated edges or silently accepted definition gaps.

One independently adjustable selection/completeness rule for a governed-only Terms Graph view; reuses the generic Terms Graph and existing Term admission authority, with no new graph kind or Term identity.
changes.identity_admission: No R1454 in repository governed Markdown/JSON/NDJSON/TOML content or Git history filenames; previous assigned Requirement number R1453. General tier under R1431 because this specifies a derived set, not graph identity or concrete Carrier.
